tools.name: contact_broker
tools.description: Asks a Rise Real Bali broker to message the visitor on WhatsApp about buying property in Bali. Needs a name and a phone number.

tools.name: request_property_shortlist
tools.description: Asks a Rise Real Bali broker for a shortlist of Bali villas or apartments that fit the visitor's goal and budget. A broker replies on WhatsApp or by phone.

message.description: Area, number of bedrooms, when you plan to buy

tools.name: rise_contact
tools.description: Contact details for Rise Real Bali, a real estate agency in Bali, riserealbali.com: WhatsApp, email and the broker phone number. Buyers pay nothing: the seller pays the commission. The tool only returns links and sends nothing.

topic.description: What the question is about: a property, an area, a yield estimate, or selling your own property

tools.name: rise_estimate_yield
tools.description: Estimates rental yield on a Bali property with the model used by Rise Real Bali, a real estate agency in Bali, riserealbali.com: gross revenue (nightly rate × 365 × occupancy), operating expenses at 40% of revenue (management 18%, tax 10%, vacancy and upkeep 12%), net operating income, net yield on the price and payback period. An estimate, not a promise of income.

price_usd.description: Property price, in the same currency as the nightly rate (IDR on this site)

adr_usd.description: Average daily rate per night, in the same currency as the price

occupancy_pct.description: Average yearly occupancy in percent; default 70

tools.name: rise_find_objects
tools.description: Searches the open catalog of Rise Real Bali, a real estate agency in Bali, riserealbali.com on the current page: villas and apartments with the developer price and a net income estimate. Filters: area, type, bedrooms, budget, completion. Returns a list with price, area, net yield and a link to each property page.

district.description: Area name: Canggu, Pererenan, Ubud, Uluwatu, Nusa Dua, Seminyak, Umalas, Seseh, Nyanyi, Kedungu…

budget_max_usd.description: Maximum price, in the developer price-list currency
